## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `9970dffd316b0ec6410dea30323baf2c99fc8904`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #35685 (body and all 4 comments: triage, claim, the ruling record 7039615827, the os-dev-report 7041666164), PR #35864 (body, 25-file list, the net diff against main from merge base `2ad42b5d05`), and the 56 check-runs on this head as read at 2026-11-20T14:17Z. The review is read-only. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

Gates on this head: every completed run is success or skipped, including Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Type Check (workspace, source, consumer, debt ledger), Lint (ESLint, repo and tooling, CI/release/engine, docs and code guards, query-options erasure, tooling self-tests), Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate and Test Core. No run has failed. 21 runs were still in progress when read: Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Build and E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint scoped slot lookup and corpus, and Lint PM dispatch-gates. This record judges the contract only. It does not stand in for those runs, and the PR does not merge until they finish green.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set (card #35685, slice S1 as the ruling record routes it; S2 undo and S3 state-machine confirm plus drawer sync are separate PRs, and the PR says `Part of #35685`, so the card stays open):

- Per-cell autosave with no save bar, no row Save/Cancel column and no amber tint. Right. `data-table.tsx` gates the bar, the refusal banner, the row tint, the cell tint and the Save/Cancel buttons on `!selectFirst`. `drawRowActionsColumn` drops the edit-only column whenever the select-first model is on. `requestAutosave` runs from both commit paths (`saveEdit` and the handed-value path). `data-table-autosave-35685.test.tsx` pins this, and a control without the provider keeps the bar.
- Saving and saved state on the cell without moving layout. Right. It is an absolutely positioned `data-slot="cell-save-state"` span with `role="status"`, and the three new `table.*` keys are added to all 11 locales.
- A refusal keeps the typed value and shows the server reason, and Esc restores. Right. On a throw the pending edits stay, `setRowCellErrors` names each refused cell, and `CellSaveFailure` anchors the reason to the cell. Esc in the editor and on the selected cell both reach `discardCellChange`.
- Later edits on a refused row are sent together as one update. Right. `autosaveRow` sends every pending change the row still holds. A commit made during a running save is queued through `saveAgainRef`, so a row never has two writes in flight. The card's two-field example is covered by the browser evidence in the PR body (end_date refused, then `{"end_date":…,"budget":…}` sent as one PATCH).
- The "Open the record to finish this change" hint for a rule the list cannot complete. Right. `needsRecord` is true when the refusal names a field that is not an editable drawn column. Tests cover the positive case and the negative case for a drawn field.
- Only that row updates, server rewrites win, and sorted rows stay until the next load (ruling 7039615827 item 1). Right. `ObjectGrid.defaultRowSave` under `cellSelection` no longer bumps `refreshKey`. Instead, `mergeSavedRow` overlays the write's answer on the row, keyed to the row object that was read (`RowPatch.base`), so the next load replaces it. `sortBasis` keeps client sort and search on the pre-save row until a load is detected. The `OwnWrites` hold keeps ListView's `onMutation` subscriber and its bus reader from re-reading for the grid's own write. I read `data-objectstack`, which is outside the diff: it emits `emitMutation` synchronously inside `update()` before it resolves, so the hold covers the event. Other readers get no registry and still refresh. `'*'` and record-less changes are never absorbed.
- The 409 dialog is kept. Right for "Reload latest": the hold is released before the dialog, so the reload reaches the list. The next save sends the `If-Match` version the last save answered with (`writeRowGuarded` → `rememberRowWrite`).
- Space now types into the cell and no longer opens the record. This is outside the card body, but the PR body grounds it in the maintainer's own words on #35683 (comment 7037290299). The resulting master-detail behaviour (the pane opens only from the title link or a touch tap) is disclosed under Acceptance notes. I take it as grounded. `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx` is migrated, not voided, and the PR body lists both migrations, as the card's last acceptance line asks.

Public surface:

- `@object-ui/react` adds `createOwnWrites`, `OwnWritesContext`, `useOwnWrites` and the `OwnWrites` type through `export * from './data-invalidation.js'`, and `useDataInvalidation` gains an optional third parameter `ownWrites`. This is additive and named right.
- `@object-ui/i18n` adds 3 keys under `table` in each of the 11 locales. Additive, named right in the changeset body.
- `@object-ui/components` adds no prop or export. The behaviour inside `GridCellSelectionProvider`, which is already exported since #35684, changes. Named right.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: `objectGridRowPatch.ts` is internal and not on a package entry. The return types of `writeRowGuarded` and `resolveRowConflict` change inside `ObjectGrid` only. Named right as internal.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`: ListView provides `OwnWritesContext` internally, with no new prop. Named right.

Findings:

- should-fix: the 409 "Keep mine" path re-reads the whole list. `releaseOwnWrite()` runs in the catch before `resolveRowConflict`, so the overwrite `update()` it makes emits a mutation that is not held. ListView then refetches, the new rows no longer match `RowPatch.base`, and a sorted row moves at once. Ruling 7039615827 item 1 says it should stay until the next load. The fix is to re-hold around the overwrite write, or to release only on the `reload` outcome. The path is rare, so this does not block.
- should-fix: under the exported `GridCellSelectionProvider`, `autosaveRow` returns silently when the table has no `schema.onRowSave`, and the save bar is suppressed in that model. A host that mounts the provider over a data-table wired with `onBatchSave` only would stage edits that can never be sent. Today `ObjectGrid` is the only host and always passes `onRowSave ?? defaultRowSave`, so the bug is latent. The fix is to fall back to a one-entry `onBatchSave`, or to keep the bar when there is no `onRowSave`.
- nit: entries in `rowPatches` are never pruned after a load replaces their base. This costs memory only, not correctness.
- nit: Esc on the selected cell skips the discard while the row's save is running (`!runningSavesRef.current.has(rowKey)`), but Esc in the editor discards without that guard. The two paths are not the same.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening). The line appears in both the PR body and the changeset. It is right: the diff adds members to the `@object-ui/react` entry and an optional parameter, and removes or renames nothing an author can write. The line names the react members. The new i18n keys are additive too and are named in the changeset body rather than in the line (nit, no effect on the level).

Metadata-protocol: none. Right: no spec key, value or metadata type is touched.

Level: under AGENTS.md (Before Submitting, item 3), a non-protocol change ships `patch` even when it widens. The changeset `.changeset/35685-list-cell-autosave.md` gives `patch` to all five packages the diff moves (`components`, `plugin-grid`, `i18n`, `react`, `plugin-list`), and to no other package. That matches what the diff publishes. Check Changeset is success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` in the os-dev-report: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Dev flags: Grids without `cellSelection` keep the staged save bar and `onBatchSave` (related lists, dashboard tables). This is answered: #35827 is filed and tracks their migration, and it is named in the PR body and the card's slice note. The out-of-scope Vite stale-cache note is a tooling note only and needs no action. Leaving out undo, the state-machine confirm and drawer sync is answered by the slice routing in ruling record 7039615827 (S2, S3). The Space-key removal is answered by the maintainer quote cited in the PR body.
- Ruling 7039615827 item 2 (the state-machine confirm wording) belongs to S3 and is not implemented here, which is correct.
- SQL push-down: no finding. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. It removes a whole-list re-read per save. `mergeSavedRow` compares lookup ids between the write's own answer and the row already held, in memory. That is not a join SQL could do.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：对象列表页的表格改一格就立刻保存这一格，不再有“全部保存”栏、行尾按钮和黄色底；保存只更新这一行，排序列表里改过的行留在原位，等下次刷新才归位。被拒时保留输入并显示原因，Esc 恢复。空格改成和打字一样进入编辑。代码与你的两条裁决（排序归位时机、空格去掉“打开记录”）一致。
- 为什么还要返工：产品文档“表格插件”页里，“对象列表页”那一节还写着“空格打开记录”和“改完要点行尾保存或全部保存”。这次改动之后这两句都不对了，PR 里却写着“文档无需改动”。需要补这两句文档，再改正 PR 里那一行说明。代码不用动。
- 要你做什么：现在不需要。另有一点提请席位确认：协调席 7037290299 写的是“打开记录只走名称列的文字”，现在触屏轻点仍会打开记录，这是之前裁决 7035276698 定下的范围，本 PR 没有改动它。是否保留，交席位向你确认，不挡本 PR。

## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `9970dffd316b0ec6410dea30323baf2c99fc8904` · 2026-11-20T14:19Z

- **Shape**
  - Draft, base `main`, merge-base `2ad42b5d`. 5 commits, 25 files, +1312/−62.
  - `Part of #35685` (slice S1). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, at `patch` level. AGENTS.md: a non-protocol widening ships `patch`, so that is right.
  - `check-governed-merges --pr 35864`: NOT governed (0 of 25 paths), under 3000 lines.
  - The new members are exported from the `@object-ui/react` entry (`index.ts:15` `export * from './data-invalidation.js'`). They match the changeset and body declaration.

- **Against the rulings**
  - **Seat split (S1 only)**
    - Neither the undo action nor Ctrl+Z is written. The save toast is unchanged.
    - There is no state-machine confirm and no drawer sync.
    - `onBatchSave` is still declared and still wired to `defaultBatchSave` for grids without `cellSelection`. Retiring it is left to #35827.
    - No `@object-ui/types` file is touched.
  - **7039615827 item 1, 「等下次取数才归位」**
    - `ObjectGrid.defaultRowSave` under `hostCellSelection` patches the row from the write's answer instead of bumping `refreshKey`.
    - `ListView`'s `onMutation` subscription and its bus reader skip a change naming a held record. The hold spans the write. The dataSource emits `onMutation` synchronously inside `update`, and the console's `useMutationInvalidationBridge` forwards it synchronously, so the event lands inside the hold.
    - The data table's `sortBasis` keeps client sort and search on the pre-save row until a load. A sort or search change also clears it.
    - Leaving the row triggers nothing. Item 2 is S3 and is not written.
  - **7037290299 (Space)**
    - Space on a selected cell now flips only a cell that `togglesCell` accepts. Otherwise it falls through to the typing catcher. The `onRowClick` arm is removed.
    - The migrated test in `data-table-select-first-35684` asserts that Space opens the editor with " " and opens no record.
  - **Card items in S1, held against the code**
    - A commit, toggle or paste calls `requestAutosave`. The save sends ONE `onRowSave` with all of the row's pending changes, so a refused cell rides with the next edit.
    - A commit made during a running save is queued (`saveAgainRef`).
    - On a refusal the typed value stays pending, each drawn field gets its own reason, and the remaining text goes on the sent cell. `needsRecord` is set when a named field is not an editable drawn column. Esc in the editor or on the selected cell drops the kept edit.
    - The save bar, the refusal line, the edit-only column, the amber row and cell, and the row Save/Cancel are all gated `!selectFirst`. Grids without the provider are unchanged.
    - A 409 releases the hold before the dialog, so "Reload latest" still re-reads.
    - The next `If-Match` is taken from `rememberRowWrite`.
  - **`mergeSavedRow`.** It writes the answer only over keys the row already holds, and keeps an expanded lookup when the answer names the same id. `RowPatch.base` lets the next load's row object replace the patch.

- **REWORK, must-fix: the published docs now contradict the change, and `Skills-docs: none` is not true**
  - `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`, § "On an object's list page", has two stale sentences:
    - `:373-374`: "Space opens the record (a checkbox cell flips instead…)". After this head, Space types into the cell like any key, and a two-state cell flips.
    - `:382-383`: "Commits are the grid's own staged edits: the row's Save / Cancel and the Save All bar save them, as before." After this head, each commit saves at once, as one update for its record. The page should say what the changeset says:
      - a saving/saved mark on the cell;
      - a refusal keeps the value with its reason, Esc restores, and later edits on the row go with it;
      - the open-record hint;
      - the row is redrawn from the answer, so a sorted row stays until the next load;
      - the 409 dialog is unchanged.
  - Optional, same page: § "Batch Editing & Multi-Row Save" (`:420+`) can say in one clause that it describes grids without the list page's select-first model.
  - Then correct the body's `Skills-docs:` line so it names this page. The skills half of that line holds: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` does not teach the bar or the key.
  - This is a docs-only push. No code or test changes, and the derived gates do not change family.

- **Should-fix, seat's call: this push or a row on the evaluation sweep card**
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json`, the write-feedback item.
  - Its `variants[1]` tells the tester to double-click a Priority cell on a task list, "change it, then Save row or Save All". On a `ListView` task list neither button exists after this head. The commit itself saves, and the "1 row saved" toast still follows.
  - The variant needs its wording changed and a revision entry. `knownGaps[1]` names the same "Save All" toast and should be updated with it.

- **Nit, no head move needed**
  - `ObjectGrid` takes `useOwnWrites()` for its own row load whether or not it is the list's `cellSelection` grid. A grid of the same object nested under a `ListView`'s provider (for example a self-related child grid in the list's drawer) skips a change to the record that the outer list holds, for the length of that write.
  - Passing the host registry to the row load only when `hostCellSelection` is set closes this. It can wait for S2.

- **Question for the seat, not this PR**
  - 7037290299 also says 「打开记录只走名称列的文字」, but a touch tap still opens the record. That scope comes from 7035276698, and this PR does not change it.
  - The 速读 discloses it, and the same comment says the way records open is being re-discussed on its own card. Confirm with the maintainer whether touch tap stays.
